SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA

Administer parenteral therapy initially then can be converted to appropriate

oral therapy.

# Treatment

Treat for 4 weeks

[Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO BID \($\) R,DI](psozid2-ciproflox-14ds-750mg-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciproflox-14ds-750mg-po-bid)

References:

Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints

Sanford keyword: Septic arthritis
